name: Geolocation
description: Resolves client IP addresses to a coarse city using a locally cached IP-geolocation database.

databaseUrl.label: Database URL
databaseUrl.help: MMDB source. Defaults to the monthly DB-IP City Lite build. `{yyyy}` and `{mm}` expand to a release month; the previous month is tried when the current one is not published yet.

attributionText.label: Attribution text
attributionText.help: Shown wherever results appear. The default database is CC BY 4.0 and requires this credit; change it only alongside databaseUrl.

attributionUrl.label: Attribution link
attributionUrl.help: Link target for the attribution credit.

refreshDays.label: Refresh interval (days)
refreshDays.help: How old the cached database may get before it is downloaded again. Defaults to 30.
